bends.note: Front lip fold, 74 deg (old B1, unchanged). The line runs the full 106 mm from corner relief to corner relief. Sections show a convex outer and inner arc along its whole length.

Left wall fold, front half, 90 deg, outer skin (old B2, unchanged). It runs 56 mm from the front corner relief to the B6 relief. A real arc (outer radius about 5 mm) is present along its whole length.

Right wall fold, front half, 88 deg (old B4, unchanged). Inner skin only: the right wall's outer face is not segmented. It runs 57 mm relief to relief. Inner and outer arcs (radius about 3 and 5 mm) are present along its whole length, and the apex sits on the outer arc.

Floor crease, 17 deg, outer skin (old B6, unchanged). Both skins kink sharply between two flat planes, and there are relief holes at both ends. It is a formed bend, not a rolled kink, and the line covers 100%.

Back-right tab fold, 113 deg, outer skin (old B7, fixed). Patch 11 (with 14) is the gently curved, about 13.6 deg run-in facet of the same bend, so it is merged into the floor side. That lets the support span the whole 38 mm tab. Before, the floor-5 edge sat more than 13 mm from the sharp for s<0, which made the old line 15.8 mm long (about 41%). I re-ran the tool's compute_bend in memory on the prep points with this pairing (nothing written). Result: 38.4 mm, included 66.6 deg (unchanged), coverage 1.0, outer skin, plane-A rms 0.06 (plane 5 dominates). New line s from -22.5 to 15.8 against a tab spanning -22.4 to 15.5, so about 100%.
